description: Ministry of Water Supply - Constructions of Mahapathana water Storage Tank and Access Road (KR I) of Panwila Zone of Medadumbara Panwila Integrated Water Supply Project, Kandy North Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project, Panwila Zone  of Medadumbara Panwila Integrated Water Supply Project
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for water supply projects. It describes specific parcels of land, their boundaries, extents, and the claimants, under the authority of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects." While a government minister is named, the core subject matter is land, not government personnel or structural changes, so specialized Type 4 takes precedence over government-related types.
